Gordon Biscoe appears to be looking at the watch in disbelief but it was a comfortable 58 at the bell for Richard O'Hara who ran out an easy winner. Alan Painter, a youngster of 39, was the only other runner inside 2 minutes. Pat Lyttle is still in touch at this point but his legs are about to part company with the rest of his body any second!
Not quite so young Alan Painter set a club Veterans best over 800m in Match 5. Gladwin won't be 40 'til 2003 Alan so you might hold on to that one for a while!
Alan Painter and Dave Mole were new Vets this track season and both set club records. Alan ran 1.59.9 for 800m on his 40th Birthday, reducing that time to 1.59.1 in a Rosenheim League match.

Alan Painter had a fine win in the American Banks Vets mile at Chrystal Palace on September 3rd with a time of 4.50. On the Road Charles Dickenson had some good races - 2nd Vet in the 1988 Hogs Back, 2nd Vet in the Drapers Tool 10K.

Against Hillingdon AC at Ruislip on January 19th Alan Painter scored well with 33:07 from Laurie O'Hara 4th in 33:16 and Charlie Walker 18th in 38:51, and a fortnight later, on February 3rd, Alan took 5th in 31:02 against Cambridge H at Bexley.
